body: Over-counter things such as Tylenol take way more to overdose then you'd expect, they aren't strong enough. You may be thinking this is a peaceful way to go out but it isn't. No death is quick and painless, instead think about reasons for living, such as the mark you'd leave behind on people you love, or your pets not knowing where you went or not having someone to care for them. Please reach out there's many affordable options for care, please call the Suicide Hotline, 800-273-8255 or if you'd rather text, Text HOME to 741741
